place.source_title: Cannelton Cotton Mill, Worker's Housing Type A, Fourth Street

brief: One unit of a long two-storey cotton-mill workers' row of about 1850: plain siding, a door and window per floor, a gabled roof shared along the row; modelled as a single house. Record gap: 2 photos.

facade.notes: Cannelton Cotton Mill workers' housing, Type A (1850): a long two-storey frame row of company houses, a chimney per unit along the ridge, doors with steps up from the sidewalk, a stone foundation; utility lines along the street

why.note: company housing for a cotton mill (Cannelton, 1850): long frame rows of identical units, each with its own door and chimney
